newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Grafton Group invests in UK builders firms.
newsitem.headline: Grafton Group invests in UK builders firms.

text.p: Grafton Group Plc said on Wednesday that it had acquired British FKS Builders Merchants in Newbury for 2.6 million sterling.
It also announced that it made a strategic investment in British Dredging Plc to the tune of 6.33 million sterling.
"Since the start of 1997, Grafton Group has, in line with its defined strategy, significantly increased its market penetration in the UK," Grafton said in a statement.
It said the acquisition of FKS complements and strengthens the group's network of builders merchanting branches in the south of England.

In a separate statement Grafton said it had invested 6.33 million sterling in British Dredging, a builders merchants business which manufactures and supplies concrete block and other concrete products.
The investment was made through the purchase of 4.367 million ordinary British Dredging shares held by Redbird Holdings SA, approximately 24.93 percent of Dredging's entire issued share capital.
"This investment gives us a strategic stake in a UK builders merchanting company that is closely aligned to Grafton," Executive chairman Michael Chadwick said.
Chadwick said Grafton has been expanding its position in the UK for the last three years and now has annualised sales in excess of 80 million sterling in the UK.
